name: LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) Collaboration
notes: lz.lbl.gov lists Rick Gaitskell as Spokesperson and Simon Fiorucci as Operations Manager (read 2026-09-16). No leadership list is recorded in the Atlas for this collaboration.
No institution-level member list is recorded in the Atlas for this collaboration: the institution roster is not published as a list on lz.lbl.gov.

summary.plain: The international team of about 250 scientists from 39 institutions in six countries that built and runs the LZ dark matter detector in South Dakota.
summary.technical: LZ Collaboration: ~250 scientists, 39 institutions across the US, UK, Portugal, Switzerland, South Korea and Australia; formed from the LUX and ZEPLIN programmes and operating the 7-tonne dual-phase xenon TPC at SURF.
